resources.string: Wind direction and speed, turned to your heading
Example of the wind field with these settings: wind %1$s, arrow pointing ahead to the right.
A remote button set to \"Switch wind units\" changes it during a ride.
Speed goes from green to red as the wind picks up. Tap the field during a ride to switch.
With a coloured tile the arrow is black (white at night), so it stays easy to read.
Colours the whole tile, from green in calm air to purple in a gale. Text and arrow stay black (white at night).
The strongest gust in brackets after the speed: 5.2 (9) m/s.
